working_definition: Nurse cells of the adult ovary that have exited mitosis and are endoreplicating (Li et al. 2022, Manual Annotation).

best_match.fbbt_definition: One of a group of 15 germ cells that lie anterior to the oocyte within the egg chamber. Their cytoplasm is contiguous with the oocyte via ring canals.

justification: Nurse cells are post-mitotic and endocycling by nature; the qualifiers describe their state rather than a separate type, and FBbt has no finer stage term.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Cyst cell that will develop into a nurse cell.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Pre-differentiation stage; label says nurse cell.
